source: Social Security's primary insurance amount formula: 90% of average indexed monthly earnings up to the first bend point, 32% to the second, 15% above; 2026 bend points in the region of $1,226 and $7,391; the taxable wage base near $176,100 (2025) rising with wages; full retirement age 67 for those born 1960 or later; a reduction of 5/9 of 1% a month for the first 36 months claimed early and 5/12 of 1% beyond, and 8% a year of delayed credit to 70.
confidenceNote: Bend points and the wage base are recalled and rounded; the real ones are published each October. The estimate assumes the current income every working year, no indexing, and a career from 22 — an approximation to make the number visible, not a statement.
note: Dollars, monthly, for the bend points; annual for the wage base. D-088.
